title: Refactor TypeScript Kit API to Stateful with Five Kit Kinds
description: Refactor TypeScript Kit API to Stateful with Five Kit Kinds
summary: Refactored all ~35 applyDiff functions in compose/js/index.ts from functional (returning new objects) to in-place mutation (void return). Renamed kit kinds to dev/local/archive/remote/transport. Added Kit Kind classes (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit). Updated all callers in index.ts (~56 call sites) and sketchpad/index.tsx (9 call sites + 3 transact methods). Fixed JsonFileKitStore save interleave detection using mutationGeneration counter instead of reference equality. All 230 tests pass.
